firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently watched a reality TV show starts.
clarifications: The first player’s turn marker goes first in the line; after each turn, that marker moves to the end and the player to the left becomes first.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF/printed page 1 gives the reality-TV criterion and marker setup; page 2 describes the rotating first player. The same room tiles, reversible board and mode set match inventory BGG 127024; the BGG files listing identifies the English rules as publisher Matagot’s.
